**Describe the bug**
A clear description of what the bug is (e.g., incorrect Perft node count at Depth X).

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior. Include fen/pgn string if applicable.

**Environment:**
 - OS: [e.g. Ubuntu 22.04]
 - Compiler: [e.g. Clang 17]
 - CMake Version: [e.g. 3.25]
